topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Well, it seems the Lord has favored me with a new turn. Since the harvest, I've been eyeing the blacksmith's forge, dreaming of the clink of metal and the dance of flames. Now, the village council's agreed, and I'm to apprentice with old Master Finn, the onlysmith who's seen better days than the last sow's farrowing. They say it's my hands, steady as stone, or perhaps it's my knowledge of the earth that might find favor in the forge. Whatever it be, it's a change from the plow and a chance to give more to this village than just the grain from the fields. I'll start come the first bell of the week, and I pray Saint Gregory watches over my hammer and tongs.
